pictures.name: RO1-The-Pebbles
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light. Fourth-century Egyptian desert at dawn: Paul, an old monk with a long white beard, sun-darkened weathered skin and a patched brown linen robe, sits cross-legged on a reed mat at the doorway of a small mud-brick cell, a heap of smooth pale pebbles in his lap. Eyes closed in prayer, he lets one pebble fall from his fingers onto a small pile on the sand beside him. Rose-gold sunrise over dunes, deep blue shadows. Paul in the middle. Patient, devoted, still. No text, no letters, no logos.

Hot white afternoon light, long blue shadows. Paul in the middle. Discouraged, deflated. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: RO3-Macarius
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Inside a simple desert cell at evening, a clay oil lamp on the floor. The elder Macarius, a kind-faced monk in his sixties with a full grey beard, bright warm eyes and an undyed cream wool robe, sits weaving a basket from palm leaves, smiling gently as he speaks. Across from him, Paul (an old monk with a long white beard, sun-darkened skin, patched brown linen robe) listens, a few pebbles resting in his open palm. Gold lamplight on both faces, deep blue night through the doorway. The two monks in the middle. Wise, comforting, warm. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: RO4-Knotted-Strings
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold candlelight. A medieval stone village church at dusk: in the foreground, ordinary farming folk in rough wool tunics and headscarves, a weathered older man and a young mother, kneel on the stone floor, each passing a long cord of tied knots through their fingers, lips moving in prayer. Behind them in the candlelit choir, monks in black habits chant from great open books with blank pages. Warm gold candlelight, deep blue shadows in the arches. The knotted cords in the middle. Humble, devout. No text, no letters, no logos.

Her thumb rests on one bead. Behind, softly blurred, a warm lamp and a dark blue window. The beads in the middle of the frame. Intimate, peaceful, prayerful. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: RO6-Today-Mirror
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative oil painting in the same sacred style, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, of a modern scene today: inside a parked car at dusk, a wooden-bead rosary with a small crucifix hangs from the rearview mirror, gently swinging, catching the last gold sunlight through the windshield. Beyond the glass, a quiet suburban street with streetlights just coming on and a deep blue sky. On the passenger seat, an open purse with car keys. The rosary in the middle. Familiar, tender, everyday. No text, no letters, no logos, no readable signs.
